summary:
Plan written to plan.md. The tower stacks eight identical segments, each a notched square that flares out one block every 6 courses, from 62 wide at its foot to a 76-wide lit ledge, so each one overhangs the next like a pagoda.
It sits on a stepped pedestal (76 tapering to 62) with gold coin medallions on all four faces. The crown is a lit observatory, three flared pinnacle tiers, a stepped cap and a slim spire with red aircraft lights.
Cyan glass on a gray mullion grid with dark floor lines, gold corner light strips and ruyi ornaments make it read as Taipei 101 at dusk; the six-storey mall steps down in terraces from y 68 to y 35. `chain` is left out because the toolkit's block check doesn't recognise it.
